caption_lines.text: Bimanual dinner-table manipulation — dual SO-101 in MuJoCo
Open the top drawer, pick up the fork and the spoon and lay them either side of the place setting, put the plate on the mat, then set the mug down to the right of the plate.
Measured over 10 randomized seeds: drawer_open 10/10  fork_placed 0/10  spoon_placed 0/10  plate_placed 6/10  mug_placed 0/10
16/50 sub-goals against a 0/50 no-policy control on the same seeds and the same scorer.

NOT SHOWN: task_success is 0/10 -- the table is never fully set. Never earned on any seed: fork_placed, spoon_placed, mug_placed. No learned policy: envs/controller.py is scripted IK and reads no camera.
This frame is the real final state of seed 0 after 125.0 s of simulation -- earned here: drawer_open, plate_placed.

not_claimed: The cover shows one real final state and the measured tallies beside it. It does not show a completed dinner table: task_success is 0/10. fork_placed, spoon_placed, mug_placed were never earned on any seed. The controller is scripted IK over privileged simulator state, not a learned or camera-driven policy, and no Intel hardware measurement appears on this image.
reproducibility: Deterministic on this machine: same seed, same controller bytes, same MuJoCo build. The sha256 is an integrity anchor for THIS file; a different GPU or font build re-renders equivalent pixels, not identical bytes.
